Alternate comment: This property associates a contract with an exact title supplied by the notary who enacted the contract.
This property associates a contract with a title used to identify the contract within the database.
This property connects a contract with the notary responsible for enacting the contract.
This property assocaties a contract with the date of its enactment. A contract might also have addenda composed on later dates and in this case the property associates these dates as well.
This property associates a contract with a brief description of the contract created for the database.
This property connects a contract with the archival item housing the contract.
This property connects a sales contract with a person named as a seller in the contract.
This property connects a sales contract with a person named as a buyer in the contract.
This property connects a sales contract with an item of sale indicated in the contract.
This property connects a contract with a person named as a procurator in the contract.
This property connects a contract with a person named as a guarantor in the contract.
This property connects a contract with a person named as an additional participant (either directly or indirectly) in the contract and who is not connected by any other properties of the contract.
This property connects a contract with a geographical placed mentioned in the contract (apart from the place of enactment).
This property connects a contract with another contract referred to by the notary.
This property connects a contract with a geographical location where the contract was enacted.
This property connects a contract with a person named as a witness in the contract.
This property associates a contract with a textual description of the entity who is the rights holder of the contract.
This property connects a contract with a unique identifier for the contract (generally an UUID-4 identifier).
This property connects a contract with an informal note related to the contract which is intended for internal use only.
